special_apis.special_handling: Still available in WinUI 3 but the picker requires an HWND; CredentialPicker.PickAsync uses the app window handle. Not the cause of failure here (content never rendered), but worth noting for the API-mapping table.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated app builds (0 errors) and launches, but every scenario content Frame is blank; no scenario controls exist in the UIA tree; every Launch invoke fails (target not found). Score 0/3.
errors_encountered.root_cause: NavigationView used MenuItemsSource (x:Bind Scenarios) to populate items, but the SelectionChanged handler tested `args.SelectedItem is NavigationViewItem`. With MenuItemsSource the SelectedItem is the bound DATA item (Scenario), not a NavigationViewItem, so the cast fails, ScenarioFrame.Navigate is never called, and the content Frame stays empty. Additionally the constructor set NavView.SelectedItem = NavView.MenuItems[0], but MenuItems is empty when MenuItemsSource is used, so no initial navigation occurred either.
errors_encountered.fix: In SelectionChanged, read the data item directly: `if (args.SelectedItem is Scenario s) ScenarioFrame.Navigate(s.ClassType);` (or, when using literal NavigationViewItems in MenuItems, read item.Tag). Set the initial selection from the source collection (Scenarios[0]) not NavView.MenuItems.
